solutions.title: Used-array backtracking
solutions.strategy: Track which input indices have been used in the current permutation.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are n! permutations and each result copies n values.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output dominates; path and used flags use O(n).

solutions.title: In-place swaps
solutions.strategy: Swap each remaining value into the current position, recurse, then swap back.

timeComplexity.explanation: All n! permutations are emitted and copied.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output dominates; recursion depth is O(n).
